blocks.text: The Momcozy Breast Milk Cooler keeps your milk fresh for over 24 hours with 360° surround cooling. Simply freeze the cooling tube, place it in the cooler, and you’re ready to go. With a 22oz capacity and separate storage bottles, it’s perfect for multiple pumping sessions, preventing spoilage. The inner bottles are easy to clean with the Momcozy bottle washer, and the cooler’s compact design makes it travel-friendly. Made from BPA-free, food-grade materials, it ensures safety and peace of mind for moms on the go.Trusted by many mothers, this product also makes an excellent gift for breastfeeding moms
